Ebook: Show up in the answer. Field guide 01 for Philadelphia owners on getting recommended by ChatGPT, AI Overviews and Perplexity.
What is real: every number is sourced (Semrush 2026 AI Visibility Index; the 35 AI visibility score and 1,000+ keywords are the Detroit Dispensing case study on needmomentum.com).
Open: chapter 2, 4, 5 and 6 spreads; the author line; whether Mac wants his name on the cover.

Grammar mirrors the Sept 5 proof collection and the signal homepage: fixed 100px header that tightens on scroll, handwritten caption sliding out as the mark hops, MENU wiping a panel in from the right, single-stroke icons that move the way each lane metaphor does.
No prices on the public page: Mac (Jun 8) and Melissa (Aug 11) set no public AI pricing with a Get a Quote CTA. The Sept 5 kit proposals (D04 to D06) stay in the one-pager and deck addendum. Market: SMB-tier AEO retainers run $1,500 to $3,000 entry; WebFX (Harrisburg) publishes $3,000/mo.
Phone layout still to draw. Scroll motion needs the artboard expanded or the page scrolling; in the flat canvas view the header shows its rest state.
Announcement copy says launches its AI division, Mac's own words. Check against the PRWeb release text before posting; the release headline says expands AI partnerships.
